description: Placeholder starter bindings for two-stage Latent Upscale + 1-Step Tiled Refine post-approval upscaling ('mvd upscale'). Pair with Apache-2.0 video latent upscalers (LTX-2.x / Wan 3D latent upscaler + tiled low-denoise refine sampler) to promote approved draft clips to crisp 1080p masters on 16-24 GB GPUs without RealESRGAN skin smoothing. Replace example node ids with ids from your exported ComfyUI API workflow.
